author: O' Neill Morales
review_text:
Amazing food!
Amazing people!
Amazing service!
Amazing atmosphere!
This place so far has been the best restaurant I've ever been to, compared to other high-end restaurants I've been to.
Prices are reasonable, I expected it to be more expensive due to the great quality and service.
The food was amazing, so good that I forgot to take pictures of it.
But at least I captured the dessert.
And on the weekends they have live music, very beautiful classic music as you'll see on the video.
So take your wife, girlfriend, mother or significant other here and you'll both leave happy.
You won't regret it!

author: Rene Munoz
review_text: This review is written after speaking with a person who frequents Argentina as his father is born and raised in Argentina. The main focus was the meat, as that's what Argentina is known for. I was excited about it since my family has been butchers for generations.  I asked the mixed grilled meats, medium well. A week later, I still tasted the charred exterior, the lack of flavors, and the meat was over-cooked. The decor is full of Argentina soccer glories and televisions displaying the baseball world classic. The fried Calamari was not memorable and bland. The only thing worth the price was the mashed potato. Overall, it was overpriced and not worth a second visit. Over $200!! The service took too long to take our orders, and rarely did they ask us if we needed anything.

author: John John
review_text: First, I will say this is not a WHITE TABLE CLOTH Resteraunt, but the tablecloths are white, The Resteraunt name really says a lot because they WHIP your food up. I've been to many. This food was terrible. I will never go to this restaurant again or anything close to it. The chicken empanada was terrible poor qualiy. I couldn't even pick it up because it was soggy. So I needed a fork to eat my empanadas????? Never had an Empanada like that, and I've eaten all over the world. Beef empanada was fried more appropriate, but the beef used was poor quality. The spinach empanada was clearly the one that you see coming out the shell it wasn't good either. Next , the shrimps in garlic sauce a total of 6 for 22.50, which was also horrible, and a side order of spinach was not edible. I couldn't eat it. I literally couldn't swallow the food. And a bottle of pellegrino cost 8.25? That cost 4 times the amount as one bottle in a 12 pack. Then they rush you to leave. The waiter didn't have an understanding of the menu. For example, if you dont have something available on the menu what is the most popular dish or anything you suggest is the job of the waiter. The waiters and staff did not speak english enough to suggest anything in the menu. White Table Cloth Restaurants don't have 5 to 8 men waiters and busboys  standing by the bar talking. Nobody greets you at the door. They greet you at Applebee's. For those who have eaten at AUTHENTIC WHITE TABLE CLOTH RESTAURANTS knows this is a 2.5 star restaurant at best. There's an OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE not too far from this place that's probably better. Oh yeah, I forgot the bread was good.

author: Ed Steell
review_text: Wow very nice place.. I've lived in the area for years and it wasn't until last week that I realized this restaurant is the best, great atmosphere, good prices, excellent food, I highly recommend it.

author: Carlos Mennea
review_text: My wife and I recently visited La Fusta for the Copa America final, and it was our first time dining there. Despite the hectic night, the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. We ordered a mix of empanadas (carne/beef, spinach, and jamon y queso/ham and cheese), a mixed salad, and milanesa completas. The prices were more than fair and actually cheaper than some other Argentine steakhouses in NJ. The quality and taste of the food were superb—everything tasted fresh and was seasoned to perfection. Although we didn’t get a chance to try their parillada, which they are known for, we will definitely be returning soon!
